text:
Monzo (UK) pays interest on **Savings Pots** (and matching Cash ISAs), not on the main current-account balance. Rates depend on the pot type and your plan (Free, Extra £3/month, Perks £9/month, or Max from £19/month). Variable rates can change; fixed rates are locked for the term. Figures below are from Monzo’s site.

### Instant Access Savings Pot / Instant Access Cash ISA
Variable rate, interest paid monthly, no minimum deposit, unlimited instant withdrawals (up to £1,000,000).

| Plan | Rate (AER) |
|------|------------|
| Free | 2.80% |
| Extra | 3.15% |
| Perks | 3.55% |
| Max | 3.80% |

### Select Access Savings Pot / Select Access Cash ISA
Higher variable rate if you make **2 or fewer withdrawals** a year. £500 minimum. Interest paid monthly. More than 2 withdrawals drops the rate until the pot’s anniversary (to 2.65% on Free/Extra, or 3.10% on Perks/Max and similar plans).

| Plan | Rate (AER) with ≤2 withdrawals |
|------|--------------------------------|
| Free / Extra | 3.45% |
| Perks / Max | 3.70% |

### Fixed Rate Savings Pot / Fixed Rate Cash ISA
Fixed rate, interest paid at maturity. £500 minimum. You can withdraw early by closing the pot, but you lose some interest (penalty shown before you confirm). Same rates on every plan:

- **1 year:** 4.70% AER  
- **2 years:** 5.10% AER  
- **3 years:** 5.25% AER  

### Other
- **Under-16s savings:** 2.80% AER (variable).  
- **Savings Challenge:** 0% on Free; **5% AER** (variable) on Extra, Perks, and Max.

Cash ISA versions pay the same rates as the equivalent non-ISA pots, but interest is tax-free and counts toward your annual ISA allowance (£20,000). Eligible deposits are FSCS-protected up to £120,000 per person.

Rates change, so check the latest in the Monzo app or on [monzo.com/savings-isas](https://monzo.com/savings-isas) before you open a pot.
